skill.summary: Orchestrate multi-agent teams by defining roles, managing task lifecycles, enabling handoffs, and enforcing review workflows for sustained collaboration.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-team-orchestration skill.

- Provides a structured playbook for orchestrating multi-agent teams with defined roles (orchestrator, builder, reviewer, ops).
- Guides setup of task lifecycles including state transitions, handoffs, and review workflows.
- Details protocols for clear handoff communication, artifact sharing, and review steps to maintain quality.
- Includes common pitfalls and recommendations for effective multi-agent collaboration.
- Reference files link to best practices for team setup, task states, communication channels, and workflow patterns.
- Advises when to use (and not use) this skill for team workflows.
